Because our focus is on the Vietnamese language, we utilize the BARTpho tokenizer [15], a word-level tokenizer speci cally pretrained on Vietnamese high-scale datasets.
Operating at the word level and pretrained on Vietnamese data, BARTpho helps reduce word segmentation errors, resulting in more linguistically appropriate word representations.
